items.statement: The reported tilted SCH3 model relaxes to a bridge-like site displaced about 0.2 Å toward hcp, with measurable surface corrugation.
items.expected: Submission documents a relaxed bridge-like geometry and quantitative site/corrugation evidence.

items.statement: The Au-S hybrid feature is identified from projections on sulfur and Au atoms bonded to sulfur and energies are aligned to EF.
items.expected: Submission gives an object-specific projection/assignment procedure and EF alignment evidence.

items.statement: The occupied Au-S hybrid HOMO feature is located around 1 eV below EF.
items.expected: Reported energy_relative_to_fermi_eV is approximately -1.0 eV with stated extraction uncertainty.
